reason: I'll download it this week just to poke around, the way I do with every new local app - but I never finish a first booking unless something pushes me over, a discount code, a friend's referral, something. This ad doesn't give me that, so it just sits on my phone like the last three.
objection: Identity verification tells me the freelancer is a real person, not that they're good at the job. I've called JustDial numbers and gotten dead ends before - a slicker app with a verified badge doesn't automatically fix 'will this person actually show up and do decent work.' And I still don't know if this is genuinely built in Tamil or just translated labels with English support bolted on.
would_change_my_mind: A first-booking discount or referral code to actually push me to book, plus real customer ratings/reviews per freelancer (not just an identity check), and proof the Tamil experience is native, not translated.
